name: Feferi Peixes
source:
The last of the trolls befriended in Pesterquest, Feferi makes her debut in Volume 10 alongside Eridan.

As the only fuchsia-blooded troll, Feferi is the heiress to the Alternia throne, and has some big plans to change the way trollkind operates. A bubbly and energetic girl, Feferi is nevertheless lonely and wants to make new friends.
